domain.description: Domain name extracted from the resource record data.

email.description: Email address extracted from resource record data or mail policy text.

ip.description: IP address or network extracted from address records, SPF or service binding hints.

minimum.description: SOA minimum negative-cache TTL in seconds.

port.description: Service port extracted from SRV or service binding data.

priority.description: MX preference, SRV/URI priority, or service binding priority.

queried-name.description: Absolute DNS query name, without the final root dot. May differ from rrname when aliases are followed.

rdata.description: Complete resource record data in DNS presentation format; preserves TXT quoting, SOA fields and unknown types.

refresh.description: SOA secondary refresh interval in seconds.

rrclass.description: DNS resource record class, normally IN.

rrname.description: Owner name in DNS presentation form, without the final root dot except for the DNS root itself (.). Text permits root, wildcard and escaped owner names.

rrtype.description: DNS resource record type mnemonic, or TYPE followed by its numeric code.

section.description: DNS response section where this record was observed. Authority and additional records describe their own rrname, not necessarily the queried name.

soa-email.description: SOA responsible mailbox converted from DNS RNAME notation to an email address.

text.description: Decoded TXT/SPF character strings concatenated in order; rdata preserves original chunk boundaries.

ttl.description: Remaining time to live in seconds as returned by the resolver.

url.description: URL extracted from resource record data; no HTTP request is implied.

description: A single DNS resource record observed through active resolution, preserving its query name, owner, type, class, TTL and complete RDATA alongside extracted correlation pivots. Object first_seen and last_seen record observation time, not zone history.
name: dns-resource-record
